title: Boichi's The Marshal King Manga Resumes
content: Viz Media is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story: A two-fisted tale about desperadoes and the marshals who hunt them! High-octane adventure in the American Wild West as imagined by the genius illustrator Boichi , the artist of Dr. Stone and One Piece: Ace's Story !
author: ANN

title: Famed Akira, Naruto Animator Yuji Yanase Dies at 59
content: After at least four decades of contributions to the anime industry, Yuji Yanase has left the industry following a tragic incident. The acclaimed animator Yuji Yanase rose through the industry as you would expect of any animator, working hard at his craft and showcasing his passion.
author: ComicBook

title: New Detective Conan Anime Special Lets Fans Deduce Culprit
content: A livestreamed 30th anniversary special for the Detective Conan anime announced on Saturday that a new original Detective Conan anime special will air in Japan. For the first time in the franchise , this Misohitojima no Satsujin (The Misohitojima Murder Case) anime will have viewers attempt to deduce the culprit.
author: ANN

title: Netflix Has Raised UK Subscription Rates
content: Deadline has announced that Netflix raised its UK subscription rates on Friday September 3. The pricing applies to both new and existing customers. The Standard with Ads subscription has risen 33.4% from £5.99 to £7.99 a month.
author: ANN

title: Hindi Dub of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable Anime Streams on Muse India YouTube Channel
content: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Diamond Is Unbreakable adapts the fourth part of Hirohiko Araki 's manga and debuted in April 2017. The anime season ran for 39 episodes, or three cours .
author: ANN

title: 2026 Crayon Shin-chan Film Opens in the Philipines in November
content: Muse Asia announced on Thursday that its screening of Eiga Crayon Shin-chan Kikikaikai! Ora no Yōkai Bake-shon ( Crayon Shin-chan The Movie Super Strange! My Yōkai Monster Vacation), the 33rd 2D anime film in the Crayon Shin-chan series, will open in the Philippines in November. The film opened in Japan on July 31.
author: ANN

title: Ani-One Asia Streams Kaiju No. 8 'Narumi's Week at Work' Short Anime
content: Ani-One Asia announced on Friday that it has licensed the new " Narumi's Week at Work " ("Narumi no Heijitsu") anime short of Naoya Matsumoto 's Kaiju No. 8 manga, and will begin streaming the anime on Saturday, September 5 at 7:00 p.m. GMT +8.
author: ANN

title: MVM Announces Date Changes
content: MVM has announced in its X/Twitter feed that some of its upcoming home releases have been delayed. 2.5 Dimensional Seduction , pictured right, has gone back to October 26; I Parry Everything has gone back to November 23.
author: ANN

title: Anime Composer Yasuharu Takanashi Will Appear With His Band in Camden on October 2
content: The concert is described on the Dingwalls website as "an explosive fusion of anime epicness and the power of live metal." Yasuharu Takanashi has composed music for anime such as Naruto Shippūden , Fairy Tail , Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Crystal , Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , Kengan Ashura , Fresh Pretty Cure ,…
author: ANN

title: Disney+ in UK Adds First 92 Episodes of One Piece
content: The website AnimeBluRayUK reports the opening three TV anime seasons of One Piece , consisting of the first 92 episodes, are now available on Disney+ in the UK. The episodes are available both subtitled and English-dubbed.
author: ANN
